subject: sigmahack
caption:
If the first line sounds like a course, it is not a hook.

Say the useful thing in four words. Then stop fiddling with it.

slides.headline: Your hook is doing too much.
If it sounds like a course, cut it.
slides.body: A course sells a feeling. You are posting a point.

slides.headline: That is the whole test.
slides.body: If the opening is mush, the rest will not save it.

slides.headline: Read the first line aloud.
slides.body:
Would you say this to a friend
Does it name a real thing
Can you stop after four words
Is the joke doing any work

slides.headline: Post the plain line today.
slides.body: Cheeky is fine. Fog is not.
